facts.fact: Universal Ads' geo lift study portfolio shows a median of about 5% incremental lift and about 1.1x iROAS, with top-performing campaigns reaching 7%+ lift and about 2x efficiency.
facts.value: 5% median lift; 1.1x iROAS median; 7%+ top lift; ~2x top efficiency
facts.quote: anchored by ~5% lift and ~1.1x iROAS at the median, with top-performing campaigns reaching 7%+ lift and ~2x efficiency

facts.fact: Universal Ads states its campaigns can deliver about 2x higher incremental ROAS than broader CTV benchmarks, per independent third-party benchmark analyses.
facts.quote: Independent third-party benchmark analyses show that Universal Ads campaigns can deliver ~2x higher incremental ROAS than broader CTV benchmarks

facts.fact: Universal Ads reports that nearly half of incremental conversions in client results come from new customers.
facts.quote: nearly half of incremental conversions can come from new customers

facts.fact: A Premium Apparel Brand case on Universal Ads achieved 14.9% incremental lift and 1.59 iROAS.
A Home & Lifestyle Brand case on Universal Ads produced 15.2% incremental lift, with 85% of incremental sales from new customers.
facts.quote: Produced a 15.2% incremental lift, with 85% of incremental sales coming from new customers

facts.fact: A Fitness Equipment Brand case on Universal Ads recorded 18.9% and 31.2% incremental lift across multiple studies.
facts.quote: Recorded an 18.9% and 31.2% incremental lift across multiple studies

facts.fact: Free Fly Apparel's growth marketing manager said a Universal Ads test drove a 50% lower cost per incremental order.
facts.quote: driving a 50% lower cost per incremental order.

facts.fact: Universal Ads' geo lift study source is labeled as in-scope N=60 for 3P geo lift studies from 2025–2026.
facts.quote: UA Measurement Norms, 3P Geo Lift Studies 2025–2026, In-Scope N=60
